syllabus_topics: Resolution of algebraic and differential, linear and non-linear systems: analytical and/or numerical
Approximation of PDEs: Finite element calculation technique for numerical resolution on computer of partial differential equations (PDE) systems
Application to concrete mechanical engineering problems
Programming and computer implementation using Matlab/Octave
assessment_rules: The module average will be calculated proportionally to the hours. For "Resolution of Systems", there is a partial exam. For "Approximation of PDEs", the grade is based on 10% presence, 20% project, and 70% exam.
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
